caption:
Your mattress topper is deeper than your sheet's pocket.

Most fitted sheets are cut for a standard mattress, so once you add a thick topper or a pillow-top, the pocket runs out of room. The corners stretch as far as they can, then let go in the middle of the night, usually around the same spot.

This one is sized specifically for that gap, an extra deep fitted sheet only that fits mattresses eighteen to twenty-four inches thick, in a soft, wrinkle-free fabric. It's rated 4.5 stars by over fifty thousand people who bought it.
